description: This file contains implementations for miscellaneous WiFi-related utility functions, including semaphore initialization, thread daemonization, and external interface stubs for WiFi and system event management.

methods.name: int ext_sysevent_open(char * ip,unsigned short port,int version,char * id,unsigned int * token)
methods.description: Opens a system event connection to a specified IP and port, returning a file descriptor or status.

methods.name: int ext_sysevent_close(const int fd,const unsigned int token)
methods.description: Closes a system event connection identified by a file descriptor and token.

methods.name: int ext_wifi_enableCSIEngine(int apIndex,mac_address_t sta,bool enable)
methods.description: Enables or disables the CSI engine on a specified WiFi access point.

methods.name: int ext_initparodusTask()
methods.description: Initializes the Parodus task, placeholder returning success.

methods.name: int ext_wifi_getRadioTrafficStats2(int radioIndex,wifi_radioTrafficStats2_t * output_struct)
methods.description: Retrieves radio traffic statistics for a specified radio index.

methods.name: int ext_WiFi_InitGasConfig()
methods.description: Initializes Gas configuration for WiFi; placeholder returning success.

methods.name: void ext_daemonize()
methods.description: Performs daemonization of the process, setting up semaphores and detaching from terminal.

methods.name: void ext_sendWebpaMsg(char * serviceName,char * dest,char * trans_id,char * traceParent,char * traceState,char * contentType,char * payload,unsigned int payload_len)
methods.description: Sends a WebPA message; placeholder function.

methods.name: void wifi_misc_init(wifi_misc_t * misc)
methods.description: Initializes the wifi_misc_t structure with pointers to external functions.
